questions.stem: 윗글의 요지를 완성하시오: Modern songwriters' remarkable works must be (    ) in the field of modern literature.

det.korean: 인정받아야 한다(recognized).
det.analysis: 원문: 'must be recognized in the field of modern literature'
det.tip: recognized = acknowledged: 인정받다. 글의 핵심 주장.

questions.passage: The study of literature has repeatedly failed to recognize the influence of modern musical lyricists and their contributions to the evolution of language. Unlike Shakespeare, who has been studied and celebrated for his development of the English language, particularly in vocabulary and grammatical structure, modern songwriters have experienced restraints on the acknowledgement of their contributions and largely been ignored. Over the past century, we have witnessed an explosion of incredible literary works by these artists, who, through their music, have used linguistic manipulation and storytelling to enrich our language and literature. Producing lyrics of distinct and complex imagery, songwriters have had an incredible literary impact on our language. Their remarkable works, including influences on modern language development, must be recognized in the field of modern literature.
questions.stem: 윗글에서 셰익스피어와 대비하여 현대 작사가들이 대체로 받은 처우를 영어 한 단어로 쓰시오.

det.korean: 무시되어 왔다(ignored).
det.analysis: 원문: 'largely been ignored'
det.tip: ignored = overlooked = neglected: 무시된, 간과된
